title: EPICAT: Cartes familiars de Catalunya (segles XVI-XIX)
institution: Departament d'Història Moderna i Contemporània, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (Javier Antón Pelayo)
license_note: The copyright page states that all contents are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, that mass downloading of the data without permission is not allowed, and that the images remain under the licences of the archives.
notes: Catalogue and transcriptions of family correspondence in Catalan archives, 1500-1850; about 3,800 letters, mostly of the 18th and 19th centuries. Only 40 letters dated 1526-1699 (all showing a transcription on the page) fall in the period; the earliest is from 1526. Counts are ours, from the letter pages named in the site's own date histogram (api?histograma): about 12,400 words, 39 in Catalan and 1 in Spanish. No bulk download. The site files were updated on 21 September 2026.
